_note: Floor plans for every home type on the 10 m home, laid out like a standard Dubai flat or villa: an entrance hall with a guest toilet, open living and dining onto the balcony, a closed kitchen with laundry, bedrooms with en-suites and a walk-in wardrobe in the master; two-storey homes have the kitchen, dining, living majlis and guest toilet downstairs and the bedrooms and bathrooms upstairs. Metres for rooms and walls (x west→east, z north→south, -5..5; a wall's door is [from, to] metres along it); 0.5 m cells for furniture and fixtures (col 0 = west wall, row 0 = north wall; rot 0 faces south, 1 west, 2 north, 3 east). Generated layouts are checked by scripts (every fixture and bed reachable, nothing overlapping).
